newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: N.Koreans to meet Swiss trade, aid officials.
newsitem.headline: N.Koreans to meet Swiss trade, aid officials.

text.p: A North Korean delegation due in Switzerland next week on the first such mission since a top-level defection this month will meet diplomats in charge of aid and trade, Berne's foreign ministry said on Friday.

It is the first North Korean delegation to make an official trip abroad since the defection of Pyongyang's top ideologue Hwang Jang-yop, who sought asylum at South Korea's mission to Beijing on February 12.
The delegation will be headed by Vice Foreign Minister Kim Chang-ryong.
Switzerland has no trade or other commercial agreements with North Korea except a civil aviation treaty from 1995.
It is the second Swiss visit by a high-level North Korean foreign ministry official since March 1995 and a comes in response to a similar Swiss visit in Pyongyang in April 1996.

Analysts said the east Asian communist country's desperate food situation was likely to be on the agenda. The Swiss foreign ministry said no treaties had been prepared and that the talks would be more an informal exchange of views.
